steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.body: Cook **2 pounds sliced zucchini** and **1 medium onion, diced** until tender, then drain, adding salt to taste.

steps.title: Make the soup mixture
steps.body: Combine **1 can cream of chicken soup**, **2-3 grated carrots**, **8 oz sour cream** and water chestnuts (optional).

steps.title: Mix the stuffing
steps.body: Combine **8 oz stuffing mix** and **½ cup melted butter**.

steps.title: Layer
steps.body: In a pan, layer **½ of the stuffing mix**, then the cooked squash and onions, then the soup mixture, and top with the remaining stuffing.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake 30-35 minutes (or more if you want it crunchy) at 350°F.
